source_text: These estimates align with pre-scale-up community data showing a 52% reduction (pooled IR 0.48, 95% CI 0.33–0.70), but effectiveness appeared slightly attenuated in lower-incidence settings, possibly reflecting selection biases or changing sexual networks. [7]
